website.quote: The TESSERACT Collaboration is developing two experiments, SPICE and HeRALD, to search to low mass particle dark matter.

summary.plain: The international team building TESSERACT, a family of ultra-sensitive cryogenic detectors that search for dark matter lighter than a proton. It is led from Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory and includes US universities and national labs plus three French IN2P3 laboratories.
summary.technical: Collaboration behind the TESSERACT project (SPICE, HeRALD and a proposed French Ge/Si bolometer module), led by LBNL (project director D. McKinsey). Earlier papers carry the tag 'SPICE/HeRALD Collaboration'. Institutes listed by the collaboration: Argonne, Caltech, Florida State, IP2I, LPSC, IJCLab, LBNL, Texas A&M, UC Berkeley, UMass Amherst and the University of Zurich.
